event: Proposition 115 — Crime Victims Justice Reform Act — added Chapter 10 (§§ 1054–1054.10) to California Penal Code
source: California Secretary of State — 1990 Primary Election Official Canvass; California Legislative Information
constitutional_basis: California Constitution Art. I, § 30 (amended by Proposition 115 to permit mutual criminal discovery)
constitutional_floor: Brady v. Maryland (1963) 373 U.S. 83 — constitutional minimum that Chapter 10 cannot contract below
subsequent_amendment: § 1054.3(b) — added in response to Verdin v. Superior Court (2008) 43 Cal.4th 1096 (prosecution mental health expert)
